reason: The recurrent-memory experiment improved macro validation HR@10 from 0.505 to 0.535, supporting retention of its architecture and training setup, while Electronics declined from 0.420 to 0.395. These results motivate testing stronger competition among sampled candidates but do not establish the loss as the cause. Select model_design because the sole experimental change is the ranking objective, implemented inside the existing train_category loop.

plan.model_design: Replace only the mean pairwise softplus ranking term in train_category with masked sampled-softmax cross-entropy, retaining the historically successful RecurrentMemory network and its unchanged 0.2-weighted positive/negative BCE auxiliary loss to isolate the objective change. Preserve pos_scores, neg_scores, valid_positions, and allowed; mask disallowed negative logits to negative infinity, concatenate pos_scores.unsqueeze(-1) with the masked neg_scores, and compute per_position = torch.logsumexp(candidate_logits, dim=-1) - pos_scores followed by ranking_loss = per_position[valid_positions].mean(), so positions without allowed negatives contribute zero and high-scoring allowed negatives receive stronger gradients. Keep loss = ranking_loss + 0.2 * (positive_loss + negative_loss), with no temperature, sampling correction, deduplication, or changes to the existing 32-negative sampler and masks. Explicitly preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, supplied splits, history sampling, RecurrentMemory architecture, HIDDEN=96, MAXLEN=64, DROPOUT=0.25, learned item bias, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, batch size, gradient clipping, environment-controlled epoch limit with default 200, and HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG tie-breaking; retain fixed validation with 200 users/category, 99 unique negatives, seed 42, and authoritative host macro HR@10 evaluation. Preserve all function signatures and existing variable names, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four dataset routes, identical validation/prediction preprocessing, trial-local artifacts, and the unchanged predictor writer loading exactly one newly trained checkpoint per category; retain single-GPU execution within shared budgets, without ensembles, checkpoint averaging, external data, pretrained weights, hidden-test access, or separately fitted scoring components.
